name: CeraVe Moisturising Lotion | 236ml | Daily Face, Body & Hand Moisturiser for Dry to Very Dry Skin
description:
Experience long-lasting hydration with CeraVe Moisturizing Lotion, a lightweight formula suitable for use on the entire body, face, and even hands. Enriched with 3 essential ceramides (1, 3, 6 II) and hyaluronic acid, it helps restore and maintain the skin’s natural protective barrier while providing 24-hour moisture.

Key Features:

Lightweight & Versatile: Can be used on face, body, and hands.

Patented MVE Technology: Controlled-release technology delivers long-lasting hydration.

All-Day Moisturization: Provides 24-hour hydration and helps restore the skin barrier.

Gentle & Safe: Free of fragrance and oil; hypoallergenic, non-comedogenic, and non-irritating.

Moisture-Retaining Ingredients: Hyaluronic acid helps retain the skin’s natural moisture.

Keep your skin soft, smooth, and hydrated all day with CeraVe Moisturizing Lotion.
